verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents a compliance dashboard that gives a per-state status overview where users can click a state to see requirements and upcoming deadlines, which covers the deadline-visibility half of the story. Nothing in the evidence documents reminders or notifications ahead of each deadline, and nothing describes a calendar-style view across all filings. Missing for 10: documented pre-deadline reminders or alerts, a unified calendar view of filing deadlines, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can see a compliance calendar of upcoming filing deadlines and get reminders before each one

citations.quote: Get an instant overview of your company’s status in each state. Click on a state to view requirements, upcoming deadlines, and take any necessary actions.
manage everything from your compliance dashboard
